payload.comparison_population: hypertensive participants without Apparent Treatment-Resistant Hypertension
payload.symptoms: Apparent treatment-resistant hypertension in patients with chronic kidney disease
payload.supporting_quote: High-sensitivity CRP (C-reactive protein), fibrinogen, IL-1β, and IL-1 receptor antagonist were not significantly associated with ATRH.

payload.symptoms: Schizophrenia patients with hypertension noted as a characteristic
payload.supporting_quote: We found that hs-CRP levels were significantly higher in SZ patients as compared to HC. Further analysis according to clinical and socio demographical characteristics revealed a positive association with age and hypertension.
